name: new_v1_family_manus_speed_external_rest_extension_v1
rest_prior: MANUS has no labelled Rest. Reuse exactly the frozen 1,828 ROAM source-subject Rest windows to fit F0v2 thresholds. New-v1 family fit stores only channel/rate/window metadata from the same source batch; it does not estimate target signal statistics.
classifier: Same Day1 MANUS native-trial StandardScaler plus balanced LogisticRegression C=1 max_iter=2000 random_state=20260924 as the parent; no Session2/3 fit.
aggregation: Mean of at most eight disjoint 200 ms windows per native MANUS recording.
selection: Maximize Session2 pooled macro-F1, tie break by lower Session2 log loss. Session3 is descriptive and never selects an arm.
scope: Qualified public 200 Hz same-user session-transfer screen stratified by slow/medium/fast observed in every session. External cross-dataset Rest prior, no previously unseen speed, own-device 250 Hz or live claim.
